subject: general
question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

Famine
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Drought'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Famine" **refers to extreme scarcity of food.(अकाल)
 
• It typically implies a widespread hunger crisis often due to factors such as war, population imbalance, or crop failures. 
 
• **Drought: **This refers to a period of dryness especially when prolonged that causes extensive damage to crops or prevents their successful growth.(सूखा)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Drought'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Looking at the options provided:
 
 
• **Feast: **This refers to a large meal, typically one in celebration of something.(दावत)
 
• **Abundance: **This means a very large quantity of something.(प्रचुरता)
 
• **Plenty: **This refers to a large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough. (पर्याप्त)
